about: Exact pixel results of the OLD saved-sprite cleanup rules, recorded black-box on 2026-11-19 (old code at 96b84fb102) by calling its wand and brush functions on plain RGBA the way the cleanup editor calls them. Pictures and outputs are raw RGBA (width*height*4 bytes, row by row), zlib-deflated and base64-encoded; outputSha256 is the sha256 of the raw output. Wand settings are the editor controls (Tolerance, Strong, Softness, Feather); the parameters derived from them follow the spec's wand table. Strokes: the first point is the press, each next point a move; brushOptions shows the brush settings as the old rules received them (radius = max(1, size / 2); Clean's target is the current RGBA at the press point). count is the old changed-pixel total (stamp counts summed, so a pixel touched twice counts twice). afterWand: the stroke ran on the picture after that wand click, with the untouched picture as the original. randomWandCases: extra wand clicks recorded the same way on small random pictures (seeded; up to 14x14, odd alphas, noise), each with its own picture inline (raw RGBA, deflated base64); they include the rare cases where floating-point details (the order of multiplications, the exact value used for 1/sqrt(2)) change a colour channel by one.
